title: 第16章 五百年前的祖龙朝方士炼气士倭国鬼子第17章 术士的苦逼徐飞下血本赔礼
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
是傅进谦那个畜生？
听到这个名字后，陆云面色平静无波，他两世为人，历经不知道多少年的风雨，岂会如此轻易相信别人的话。
尤其是徐飞这种心狠手辣、满口谎言、惯于见风使舵的黑帮枭雄的“一面之词”
徐飞嘴里说出来的话，能有几个字是真的都得打上大大的问号。
谁知道这是不是他祸水东引、借刀杀人的算计。
不过，即便是徐飞不说，陆云也会找个好时机把傅进谦给宰掉。
毕竟，他与傅进谦这个专做人口买卖、丧尽天良的畜生之间的梁子早结下多年之久。
若非当时的自己年老体衰，又有倭国领事庇护傅进谦，陆云早就想亲自出手，送这畜生下地狱了！
突破化劲，手握极蓝武学修改器，陆云那颗沉寂了多年的杀心正逐渐苏醒。
“傅进谦……倭国领事……”
早在胤王朝还没有彻底崩塌的时候，那时国门被西洋列强用坚船利炮轰开，倭国的势力也趁机渗透进来。
这些倭国鬼子在云港市乃至沿海各地，仗着热武器的降维打击，对平民百姓烧杀抢掠、无恶不作。
甚至有的还偷偷进行惨无人道、令人发指的残酷“实验”
，这些倭国鬼子的罪行简直就是罄竹难书。
三十五年前，陆云还只是个热血方刚的年轻武者。
他那时还没有考取武举功名，面对倭寇鬼子的暴行。
陆云曾满怀激愤，仗着一身本事，多次于夜间潜入倭国人的驻地进行过暗杀与破坏，他手上也沾染了不少倭国鬼子的鲜血。
然而现实的残酷很快让陆云清醒过来。
个人的武力，在成建制、装备精良、且同样拥有忍者、诡异式神的军队和特务组织面前，他一个人太渺小、也太无力了。
陆云就曾经历过数次险死还生的围剿与追杀，他见识过那些新型重武器的恐怖威力，也领教过倭国忍者神出鬼没的暗杀术，和式神那令人毛骨悚然的诡异力量。

人力有时而穷。
在最后一次险些丧命的绝境之后，陆云怕了。
生死之间有大恐怖，他也是人，也会畏惧死亡。
陆云觉得自己已经尽力了，他拿命去拼过，去杀过数百倭寇，这已经是对得起自己的良心，也对得起这片土地。
而且，让陆云感到绝望无力的是，他隐约意识到，就算自己将来能达到更高的武道境界，比如化劲宗师，甚至传说中的更高层次。
在面对倭国那种举国之力打造的战争机器，飞机、重炮、战舰、成建制的现代化军队时，个体的力量依旧是如同螳臂当车，不自量力。
武功再高，能快得过机枪扫射？能硬扛炮弹轰炸？能飞上天去打飞机？
这种认知，让他当年选择了更为现实的路径。
考取功名，在乱世中先站稳脚跟，保住自己和身边人的性命，再图其他东西。
反正不管是胤王朝，还是大夏新国，在陆云的眼里都不是什么好鸟。
这大夏新国名义上是推翻了腐朽前朝，成立了自立自强的新国家。
但这三十年过去了，明眼人都看得清楚，它所谓的“独立”
与“主权”
，依然是脆弱不堪，处处受制于人。
整个国家的政治、经济、军事命脉，很大程度上仍被西洋诸国，以及近在咫尺、狼子野心的倭国鬼子所影响。
那些高高在上的西洋领事、倭国武官领事，在租界里如同土皇帝。
他们的意志，往往比大夏新国燕京市的一纸政令还要管用。
content_en:
Is it that beast Fu Jinqian?
After hearing this name, Lu Yun's face was calm. He had been through many years of ups and downs in his two lives, how could he believe other people's words so easily.
Especially the "one-sided words" of Xu Fei, a gangster who is ruthless, lies, and is accustomed to changing the situation.
There is a big question mark on whether any of the words that came out of Xu Fei's mouth were true.
Who knows if this is his plan to divert trouble and kill people with a borrowed knife.
However, even if Xu Fei didn't say anything, Lu Yun would find a good opportunity to kill Fu Jinqian.
After all, the relationship between him and Fu Jinqian, a ruthless beast who specializes in human trafficking, has been forged for many years.
If he hadn't been old and frail at that time, and the Japanese consul was protecting Fu Jinqian, Lu Yun would have wanted to personally take action and send this beast to hell!
Breaking through the energy, holding the extremely blue martial arts modifier in his hand, Lu Yun's murderous intention that had been dormant for many years was gradually awakening.
"Fu Jinqian...Consul of Japan..."
As early as before the Yin Dynasty completely collapsed, the country's gate was blasted open by Western powers with powerful ships and cannons, and Japanese forces also took the opportunity to infiltrate.
These Japanese Japanese devils relied on the dimensionality reduction strikes of thermal weapons in Yungang City and even along the coast, burning, killing, looting and committing all kinds of evil on civilians.
Some even secretly conduct inhumane and heinous cruel "experiments"
, the crimes of these Japanese devils are simply too numerous to describe.
Thirty-five years ago, Lu Yun was just a passionate young warrior.
At that time, he had not yet passed the martial arts examination and faced the atrocities committed by the Japanese pirates.
Lu Yun was once full of anger and relied on his skills to sneak into the Japanese garrison at night many times to carry out assassinations and sabotage. His hands were also stained with the blood of many Japanese devils.
However, the cruelty of reality soon made Lu Yun sober up.
In terms of personal force, he is too small and powerless in front of the well-organized and well-equipped army and spy organizations that also have ninjas and strange shikigami.
Lu Yun had experienced several near-death sieges and hunts. He had seen the terrifying power of those new heavy weapons, and had also experienced the elusive assassination techniques of Japanese ninjas, and the creepy and strange power of shikigami.
Manpower is sometimes poor.
After the last desperate situation where he almost died, Lu Yun was afraid.
There is great terror between life and death. He is also a human being and will be afraid of death.
Lu Yun felt that he had done his best. He had risked his life and killed hundreds of Japanese pirates. This was worthy of his conscience and worthy of this land.
Moreover, what made Lu Yun feel hopeless and helpless was that he vaguely realized that even if he could reach a higher martial arts realm in the future, such as Huajin Grandmaster, or even a higher level in the legend.
In the face of the Japanese war machine, which was built with the whole country's efforts, including aircraft, heavy artillery, battleships, and an organized modern army, individual strength is still like a mantis with its arms in front of the chariot, overestimating its own capabilities.
No matter how high your martial arts skills are, can you outrun a machine gun fire? Can you withstand artillery bombardment? Can you fly into the sky and masturbate?
This understanding made him choose a more realistic path back then.
Obtain fame, gain a foothold in troubled times, save yourself and the lives of those around you, and then pursue other things.
Anyway, neither the Yin Dynasty nor the New Kingdom of Great Xia was a good bird in Lu Yun's eyes.
This new country of Great Xia nominally overthrew the decadent previous dynasty and established a new country that was self-reliant and self-reliant.
But thirty years have passed, and anyone with a discerning eye can see clearly that its so-called "independence"
and "sovereignty"
, still fragile and controlled by others.
The political, economic, and military lifelines of the entire country are still largely influenced by Western countries and the ambitious Japanese Japanese who are just around the corner.
Those high-ranking Western consuls and Japanese military attachés and consuls were like local emperors in the concession.
Their will is often stronger than that of the Yanjing City of the New Kingdom of DaxiaThe government decree is still effective.
